configuration.question: Your class is preparing supplies for a barangay event. Which actions help everyone work together?
configuration.content_description: Drag each card into a group, or tap a card and then its group.

items.label: Leave without telling the person in charge
Ask which supplies go in each box

configuration.correct_feedback: Checking the list and asking questions help the team pack the right supplies. Telling the person in charge before leaving or about a labeling mistake lets the team plan and correct it.
configuration.retry_feedback: Think about each action’s effect. Checking and asking keep the team informed; leaving without telling anyone or hiding a mistake makes it harder to organize the supplies.

configuration.question: You notice that you put the wrong labels on the supply boxes. Help fix the mistake. Arrange the three steps for this situation. Other workplace problems may need a different order.
configuration.content_description: Drag the cards into order, or tap them in order. Tap a placed card to return it.

items.label: Correct the labels with the support you need.
Tell the person in charge what happened.
Ask which labels belong on the boxes.

configuration.correct_feedback: Mistakes can happen. Communicating and asking for help lets the team correct them.
configuration.retry_feedback: First tell someone what happened. Then ask which labels to use before correcting them.
